title: T1491.002 — Defacement - External Defacement
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Defacement - External Defacement with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.

steps.title: Recon
steps.caption: Attacker: fingerprints an old CMS on the public site and finds an unpatched plugin by reading version files and probing plugin paths. Defenders see: quiet, low-rate GET requests for files like /CHANGELOG.txt and /readme.html ; a good baseline of normal traffic makes this stand out
steps.defender: WAF, reverse-proxy and application logs record the request, payload and backend behavior.

steps.title: Entry
steps.caption: Attacker: logs in to the CMS admin panel with stolen or guessed admin credentials, or reaches it through SQL injection. Defenders see: a successful POST to the admin login from a new country or ASN (an internet provider network) and an unusual user agent such as python-requests
steps.defender: WAF, reverse-proxy and application logs record the request, payload and backend behavior.
